scope: Restore a potentially effective action; do not force it. Public species learnsets and public copied/transformed state only; never inspect hidden move identity or remaining PP to decide availability. Preserve insufficient-HP exclusion.
validation: engine-played Substitute prefix and complete chance enumeration for Quick Attack, Mach Punch and Extreme Speed, on both sides
controls for an opponent without legal priority damage, insufficient HP, hidden moves/PP invariance and copied/unknown kits
related mask, bot and library regressions
frozen native192-game replay census before and after; distinguish action eligibility from actual search choice or strength
